summary: Collapse launch-fixture directory retirement error checks while preserving NotFound and symlink short-circuit ordering.

rules.detail: Admission is explicitly not wired. No scheduler, activation, configuration defaults or launch caller. The separate ExecRuntime method never enters the existing generation-replacement path.

compatibility.detail: Durable generation intent precedes side effects. Keeper/J creation, caps, four Measured-and-true matches, launch usage, gated fork, sole-holder attachment and release are ordered. Exit usage precedes removal. Receipt identity compares B6's hierarchy-relative jobCgroup against J with the configured cgroupfs root stripped, never the filesystem path. Outcome paths must be absolute before creating J; the same journaled path is passed to B6 and read back. Real projection/fake-holder fixtures cover hierarchy-relative receipts, all cap refusals, invalid outcome paths, collisions and cleanup uncertainty.

manual.detail: No activation or pilot. A vanished J returns typed counters-unavailable, never zero or rerun. No sentinel or per-job transient scope remains.

recovery.detail: Pre-release refusal follows confirmed whole-J stop/removal. A release error also stops/removes J, propagating cleanup uncertainty, but retains the uncertain intent without refusal or retry. Fixtures cover exec failure after release with both confirmed and uncertain cleanup. Unit 8 owns restart fencing and unknown-after-host-loss.
